notes.title: Madness Beverage patch 1.5.0 is here!
notes.content:
Madness Beverage patch 1.5.0 is here! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41315534/09a8e732f7a47eab9f0e394d646caf23aafc3839.jpg[/img]

Patch notes:

- Improvements: Expanded mouse sensitivity range in settings
- Improvements: Changed FoV in game into much higher one
- Improvements: Changed visuals on Madness Drinks effects
- Improvements: Upgraded visuals of bullets, trails and some muzzle flashes
- Improvements: Upgraded visual effects while running
- Improvements: Added visual feedback on UI for low ammo
- Improvements: Improved damage output, shooting rate, reload speed and other balance issues for Rocket Launcher, Shotgun, Pulse Minigun, Unicorn Head and Forcegun
- Improvements: Enabled reload during running instead of stopping to do so


- Changes: End game music starts playing during final cutscene, not in credits
- Changes: Adjusted HP bar's colors
- Changes: Added bigger and better blood particles
- Changes: Decreased frequency of Caleb's comments during fights
- Changes: Added possibility to skip splash screen logos anytime

- Fixed problem with alignment of some UI options in Pause Menu

- Other smaller bug fixes and adjustments
